summary: FINAL: the 3.18 d source lies at (+5.32 ± 2.66, +0.20 ± 2.37)", printed (+5 ± 3, 0 ± 3)", consistent with the target within ≈2σ (z_E 2.0, 2-D p = 0.135). The old -8" Dec in pubprep (+7.9, -8.2) and audit (+2.5, -7.5) came from S98 alone: raw S32 has 14–22" errors and carries no weight. Once S32 is pointing-decorrelated (independently reproduced), every S98 recipe gives a combined (+4.5..+6.3, -2.2..+0.2)". My rerun on identical pixels shows the S98 per-set Dec depends on the recipe (audit code: -8.4" for the same 9 events, jackknife-unstable; U code: -0.3", stable). So U's 'gap-edge artefact' explains pubprep but not the audit; the S98 per-set value stays UNRESOLVED, but it does not affect the headline. Nine S98 events are correct: 3995.555 is followed by a 5.1-h data gap. Depth-capable Gaia stars lie ≥43" away (TIC 4206077 nearest), 14.2σ formally; I recommend printing '>10σ'. S6 is unusable (0.41–3.54 h from dumps; no stable treatment). 11.13 d: (+1 ± 3, −1 ± 3)", on target in all versions; pubprep's '+1 ± 4' Dec was a transcription error. Manuscript: four MINOR wording fixes (≈2σ phrasing, >10σ, 'within 10"', caption for the off-panel 84" star). Open, non-blocking: S98 recipe dependence, no known-planet control, sub-10" blends, capability of the 11" star at low depth.
